title: Anthropic Files for IPO as Wall Street Bankrolls a $63 Billion Chip Deal
en: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has publicly filed for an initial public offering, submitting its registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday. It plans to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading the offering. The filing shows explosive growth: revenue reached 16.29 billion dollars in the first half of 2026, roughly thirteen times the 1.16 billion dollars recorded a year earlier, and adjusted operating profit turned positive at about 1.62 billion dollars. Under standard accounting rules, however, the company posted a net loss of more than 80 billion dollars, mostly a non-cash charge from the rising value of convertible notes. Separately, four Wall Street giants announced a 63 billion dollar financing vehicle to buy Broadcom AI chips and lease them to Anthropic.
zh: 人工智能公司Anthropic于周一向美国证券交易委员会公开提交首次公开募股（IPO）注册文件，正式启动上市进程。公司计划在纳斯达克全球精选市场挂牌，股票代码为“ANT”，由高盛和摩根士丹利牵头承销。招股文件显示其增长惊人：2026年上半年营收达162.9亿美元，约为上年同期11.6亿美元的13倍；调整后经营利润约16.2亿美元，首次实现盈利。但按标准会计准则，公司净亏损超过800亿美元，主要来自可转换票据价值上升带来的非现金损失。另据消息，美国银行、黑石、花旗和摩根士丹利宣布设立总额630亿美元的特殊目的实体，用于购买博通AI芯片并租赁给Anthropic，芯片交付自2027年开始。
vocab: n. 注册声明（招股文件）

title: OPEC+ Set to Keep Oil Output Targets Steady, Sources Say
en: OPEC+ oil producers are likely to keep their December output targets steady when seven core members meet online on Sunday, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, as the producer group turns its focus to quota negotiations for 2027. The meeting brings together Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman. Gulf members have been boosting exports that were disrupted for months by the Iran war, although most are still pumping well below their output targets. In September, the group completed the phased rollback of a 1.65 million-barrel-per-day supply cut first agreed in 2023, and a further layer of cuts, about 2 million barrels per day, remains in place for most members through the end of 2026. No final decision has been made, the sources said, declining to be named.
zh: 三位知情人士向路透社透露，欧佩克+产油国周日的线上会议料将维持12月产量目标不变，这一产油国联盟的注意力正转向2027年配额谈判。此次线上会议由沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、阿尔及利亚、哈萨克斯坦和阿曼七个核心成员参加。海湾产油国一直在恢复因伊朗战争中断数月的出口，但多数成员的实际产量仍远低于其产量目标。今年9月，欧佩克+完成了对2023年达成的165万桶/日减产的分期回撤；针对多数成员的另一层约200万桶/日的减产，将持续到2026年底。知情人士拒绝具名，并强调尚未作出最终决定。

title: Israeli Exit Polls Show Netanyahu Camp Short of Majority After Record Turnout
en: Exit polls after Israel's parliamentary election on Tuesday showed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud-led camp trailing the main opposition bloc, with neither side close to the 61 seats needed to form a government in the 120-seat Knesset. Turnout was extraordinary: 74.3 percent by 8 p.m., the highest for that hour since 1988. Public broadcaster Kan's poll projected 11 seats for the Arab-led Joint List, whose leader called the vote "a historic day" and demanded that "the government of bloodshed must go". Opposition politician Avigdor Lieberman urged Netanyahu to step down, saying party members should oust him so the national camp could be rebuilt. Final results are due from the Central Elections Committee on November 4, and weeks of coalition bargaining are expected before a new government takes shape.
zh: 周二以色列议会选举投票结束后的出口民调显示，总理内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德阵营落后于主要反对派集团，但双方都远未达到在120席议会中组阁所需的61席。投票率异常高涨：截至晚8时达74.3%，为1988年以来该时段最高。公共广播公司Kan的民调预计阿拉伯人主导的“联合名单”党获11席，其领导人称这次投票是“历史性的一天”，并要求“这个流血的政府必须下台”。反对派政治人物利伯曼敦促内塔尼亚胡辞职，称利库德成员应将他罢免，以便重建国家阵营。中央选举委员会定于11月4日公布最终结果，预计将经历数周的组阁博弈。

title: Dollar Edges Higher Ahead of Fed Decision as Japan's Core Inflation Hits 3.2%
en: The dollar index rose for a third straight trading day on Tuesday, closing 0.35 percent higher at 102.38 as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's rate decision due Wednesday, with Fed Chair scheduled to hold a press conference shortly after. The yield on the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury note held near 5 percent at 5.001 percent, while the two-year yield, which is sensitive to policy expectations, settled 2 basis points higher at 4.745 percent. In Japan, the central bank's preferred core inflation gauge climbed to 3.2 percent in September, a three-year high and well above its 2 percent target, keeping pressure on policymakers. In the United States, October consumer confidence jumped 7.5 points to 91.7, far above forecasts, and September durable goods orders rose 1.8 percent, the largest gain in five months.
zh: 周二，在投资者等待定于周三公布的美联储利率决议之际，美元指数连续第三个交易日上涨，收涨0.35%报102.38，美联储主席将在决议公布后不久召开新闻发布会。基准10年期美国国债收益率维持在5%附近，报5.001%；对政策预期敏感的2年期美债收益率收涨2个基点，报4.745%。在日本，日本央行看重的核心通胀指标9月升至3.2%，创三年新高，远超2%的政策目标，令决策者持续承压。美国方面，10月消费者信心指数大幅上升7.5点至91.7，远超预期；9月耐用品订单环比增长1.8%，创五个月最大增幅。

title: Chinese Team Unveils World's First Photonic-Electronic 6G Chip in Nature
en: Researchers in China have developed the world's first adaptive full-band high-speed wireless communication chip based on optoelectronic fusion, according to a study published online in Nature on Monday evening. The chip, created by teams from Peking University and City University of Hong Kong, can generate signals at any frequency across a range from 0.5 gigahertz to 115 gigahertz, spanning nearly eight octaves, which solves a long-standing bottleneck in broadband wireless access. It supports transmission rates above 120 gigabits per second, meeting the peak requirements for sixth-generation mobile communication. The researchers say the design combines photonic and electronic components on a single chip, delivering high bandwidth with lower power consumption, and lays the hardware foundation for the practical use of 6G networks in the future.
zh: 周一晚在线发表于《自然》杂志的一项研究显示，中国研究人员研制出全球首款基于光电融合集成技术的自适应全频段高速无线通信芯片。该芯片由北京大学与香港城市大学的团队联合研制，可在0.5GHz至115GHz、横跨近八个倍频程的范围内生成任意频点信号，破解了宽带无线接入长期存在的瓶颈。其传输速率超过120Gbps（吉比特每秒），达到第六代移动通信的峰值指标要求。研究人员表示，这一设计将光子与电子元件集成于单一芯片，在提供高带宽的同时降低了功耗，为6G网络的实用化奠定了硬件基础。

title: Lula Wins Fourth Term in Brazil Runoff as Markets Recoil
en: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won a fourth term on Sunday, taking 51.79 percent of the vote in a runoff against right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro, electoral authorities said. Chinese President Xi Jinping sent a message of congratulations on Monday. The outcome triggered a historic sell-off of Brazilian assets: the currency plunged and prices of flagship exports such as coffee, cocoa and sugar slid, as investors priced in continued state intervention in the economy and a less market-friendly government. Bolsonaro's son flew to the United States after the defeat, and a Supreme Court judge ordered an investigation into alleged foreign funding and social-media manipulation in his campaign. Analysts say the result will complicate Washington's efforts to line up Latin American governments behind its policies on China and the Middle East.
zh: 巴西选举机构宣布，总统卢拉在周日举行的第二轮投票中以51.79%的得票率击败右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，赢得第四个任期。中国国家主席习近平周一致电祝贺。这一结果引发巴西资产的历史级抛售：货币雷亚尔大跌，咖啡、可可、糖等旗舰出口产品价格下滑，投资者预期政府将继续对经济进行国家干预，市场友好度降低。败选后，博索纳罗之子飞往美国；一名最高法院法官下令调查其竞选活动中涉嫌接受外国资金和操纵社交媒体的问题。分析人士认为，这一结果将使美国政府在对华和中东政策上拉拢拉美国家政府的努力变得更加复杂。
vocab: v. 退缩；（此处指市场）剧烈反应
